name: Mnong flour soup
summary: A M’nông soup, served beside the Êđê bitter-eggplant soup among Dak Lak’s highland dishes.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 23 May 2023 names canh bột as a M’nông specialty of Dak Lak.
howToEat: Look for it at a highland meal with the bitter-eggplant soup.
seoTitle: Canh bot — Mnong soup in Dak Lak
seoDescription: Canh bot, a Mnong soup served beside Ede bitter-eggplant soup in Dak Lak.
